title: Investment and tech firm Long Lake says it will buy corporate travel operator Amex GBT for $6.3B, citing AI's ability to modernize the business travel sector (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Investment and tech firm Long Lake says it will buy corporate travel operator Amex GBT for $6.3B, citing AI's ability to modernize the business travel sector — Investment and technology firm Long Lake said on Monday it would buy corporate travel operator American Express Global Business Travel …
